dct_description_sm: This point data layer represents 31 Milwaukee Fire Department station locations as accessed September 18, 2026. The source portal states that the dataset is refreshed nightly. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
